text:
B: Hello. Can you hear me okay?
A: Yeah. Alright. I'm Craig.
B: Tomasz. Nice to meet you, Craig.
A: Yeah, you too.
B: So, er, where are you based?
A: Swindon.
B: Ah, Swindon. I'm in West London, Hanwell, near Ealing. Not too far, M4, yeah?
A: Yeah, straight down the M4. Hour and a half if it's quiet. It's never quiet though.
B: [laughs] No. To be honest, I drive to Heathrow most days for work, I know the traffic very well.
A: What is it you do?
B: I'm operations manager for facilities management company. So cleaning, maintenance, security, for office buildings. I have six site supervisors under me. Lots of phone calls, lots of emails, you know?
A: Fair enough. Sounds busy.
B: Very busy. And you?
A: Quality inspection. At an engineering firm. I run the CMM, the measuring machine, on machined parts, aluminium mostly. Check they're in tolerance, write up the reports.
B: Ah, okay, so very precise work.
A: Yeah, sort of. Had to redo a whole batch this week, to be fair, 'cause someone set the fixture up wrong. Every part out by the same amount.
B: That's painful. Who gets the blame for that?
A: Not me. Whoever set it up. I just measure it.
B: [laughs] Good answer. In my job, everything is my fault, you know? Toilet on fourth floor is broken, client calls me.
A: Yeah.
B: Er... you have a model car, I can see behind you. Audi?
A: Yeah, that's the quattro, the rally one. I've got an A3 myself. Ten years old, but I keep it proper clean. Just put new tyres on it, weren't cheap.
B: Tyres are crazy now. I have company car allowance, so I'm driving Skoda Superb at the moment, but I'm looking at the new models online every evening. My wife says I should marry the car.
A: [laughs] Yeah, I'm the same with BMW listings. Looking at a 3 Series, maybe. Saving for a house first, though.
B: Sensible. House first. We bought in 2019, it's hard, the deposit. You are renting?
A: Er, living with my parents at the moment. Just while I save. It's sensible, yeah.
B: Of course, very sensible. In Poland this is completely normal, nobody judges.
A: Yeah. Fair enough.
B: Do you do the gym? You look like you train.
A: Three times a week. Mostly weights. Headphones in.
B: Same, three mornings, before work. And the rowing machine. We just got new ones, very nice, with screens.
A: Ours has been rammed since January. Can't get on anything.
B: January people. By March they're gone, yeah?
A: Hopefully, yeah.
B: Er, so the puzzle at the beginning, did you finish it?
A: Most of it. Didn't really read the instructions, to be honest.
B: [laughs] I read them three times and still I was not sure if I did it right. Is it—
